ālokībhūta: [Āloka+bhūta] (ti) CL=7 Which is happened due to light.
ālolenta: [Ā+lula+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Stir (or) Rummage.Āluḷenta-(A). (B) It is to be restless. Ālolenta(ti) [ā+luḷa+ṇe+anta] Rummage (or) Stir (or) Rummage, Mixed.
āloleti: [Ā+luḷa+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) Stir (or) Rummage. (B) Be frightened (or) Tremble (or) Be badly shaken. Be mixed and confused.
ālolita: [Ā+luḷa+ta] (ti) CL=7 Should stir/rummage, can be restless.
ālolitapānīya: [Ālolita+pānīya] (na) CL=7 Stirring water (or) Water which should stir.
ālopa: [Ā+lupa+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) A mouthful of rice, A mouthful of alm/rice. (2) Rob (or) Take by force.
ālopabhattaṭṭhitikā: [Ālopa+bhatta+ṭhitikā] (thī) CL=7 Accepted the alms which is the extent of a mouthful alm/rice from one home and go from one home to an other home for accepting alms (or) Pause in front of a house to receive offerings of food which is about a mouthful food/alms and stop a house an other house in sequence.
ālopakaraṇa: [Ālopa+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Making only a mouthful of foods/alms which is not too much and not little. See - Ālopauddharaṇa.
ālopapiṇḍa: [Ālopa+piṇḍa] (pu) CL=7 Cooked rice lump which is the extent of only a mouthful rice not too much not too little. See - Ālopapiṇḍadātu.
ālopapiṇḍadātu: [Ālopapiṇḍa+dātu] (ti) CL=7 One who used to offer a cooked rice lump which is the extent of only a mouthful rice.
ālopasaṅkhepa: [Ālopa+saṅkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Making a share of a mouthful alms.
ālopati: [Ā+lupa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 Take with force and destroy.
ālopauddharaṇa: [Ālopa+uddharaṇa] (na) CL=7 Take out a mouthful alms from monk"s bowl , pick up/raise that a mouthful alms.
ālopauddhāraṇa: [Ālopa+uddharaṇa] (na) CL=7 Take out a mouthful alms from monk"s bowl , pick up/raise that a mouthful alms.
ālopaṭṭhitikā: [Ālopa+ṭhitikā] (thī) CL=7 When (a monk) eats a mouthful alms, and the sequence of a mouthful alms.
ālopuddharaṇa: [Ālopa+uddharaṇa] (na) CL=7 Raise/pick up a mouthful alms with hand from monk"s bowl.
āloḷa: [Ā+luḷa+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 Disturb (or) Interrupt, Make mischief (between two persons).
āloḷeti: [Ā+luḷa+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) It stirs. (B) It causes shock (or) Be badly shaken. (C) It causes confusion.
ālula: [Ā+lula+a] (ti) CL=7 Muddy (or) Cloudy (or) Troubled. See also - Āluḷa.
ālulita: [Ā+lula+ta] (ti) CL=7 Āluḷita - Look. Ālulita(ti) [ā+lula(luḷa)+ta] (1) (A) Should stir. (B) Should move and restless. (C) Should confuse. (D) Should step on and crush. (2) (A) Not clear/clean, cloudy (or) Not clear. (B) Not stable (or) Restless. (C) Complex (or) Mix and confuse.
ālulīyati: [Ā+lula+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Should stir. Should confuse (or) Should cloudy.
ālumpamāna: [Ā+lupa+a+māna] (ti) CL=7 Should bite (or) Should cut. See - Ālumpati.
ālumpati: [Ā+lupa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 Bite it. Bite and eat.
āluppa: [Ā+lupa+ṇya] (na) CL=7 (1) A mouthful (of food), A mouthful of alms/food. (2) Take with force. See - Āluppakārakaṃ.
āluppakārakaṃ: [Āluppa+kārakaṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (1) Make a mouthful of food/rice/alm. (2) Make taking with force, Make taking with force.
āluppana: [Ā+lupa+ya+yu] (na) CL=7 Taking with force (or) Rob. See - Āluppakārakaṃ.
āluva: [Ala+ṇuva] (pu,na) CL=7 [Latāhi alīyatīti āluvo, gacchajāti. Ṇvādi.202] Potatoes (Potatoes, Potatoes plant).
āluḷa: [Ā+luḷa+a] (ti) CL=7 It is not stable (or) Be restless, Confuse (or) Cloudy (or) Not clear. See also -  ālula.
āluḷati: [Ā+luḷa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 Be cloudy (or) Not clear (or) Confuse.
āluḷenta: [Ā+luḷa+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Stirred. (B) Be frighten (or) Be badly shaken. (C) Restless (or) Not stable. (D) Be frightened.
āluḷeti: [Ā+luḷa+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A)Stir. (B) Confuse and Mix. Be doubtful.
āluḷetvā: [Ā+luḷa+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Stir, Put in disorder. (B) Shake and stir.
āluḷita: [Ā+lula(luḷa)+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) (A) Should be stir. (B) Should restless. (C) Should confuse. (D) Should step on and crush. (2) (A) Not clear (or) Cloudy, Muddy. (B) Not stable (or) Restless. (C) Mix (or) Confuse (or) Complex.
āluḷiyati: [Ā+luḷa+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Should stir. (A) Should cloudy/muddy/be not clear. (B) Should restless.
āluḷīyati: [Ā+luḷa+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Should stir. (A) Should cloudy/muddy/be not clear. (B) Should restless.
ālāna: [Ā+lā+yu] (na) CL=7 A pole/pill which is to tie, A pillar which is to tie elephant.
ālāpa: [Ā+lapa+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (A) Firstly speaking words (or) Greeting (words), Greeting words (or) Intro words. (B) Sound (or) Voice, Emit melodious sound. See also - Ālāpasallāpa.
ālī: [Ā+ala+i] (thī) CL=7 [Ala bhūsaneāpubbo, i. Dhāna,ṭī.238. Raṃkhā ī-saka. Vi,pi,dhāna] āḷi(ḷī)] - See.
ālīyati: [Ā+lī+ya+ti] (kri) CL=7 It clings, attches and subsits on (associate with). Ālīyati(kamma,kri) [ā+lī+ya+te] Should attach and associate with/subsist on.
ālokāpetu: [Ā+loka+ṇāpe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To see. To look forwards to (or) To concentrate.
āluppakāraka: [Āluppa+kārakaṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (1) Make a mouthful of food/rice/alm. (2) Make taking with force, Make taking with force.
